feeding_claim.verbatim: produce high-quality, pasture raised grassfed beef.

notes: Checked the farm's online store (homepage, producer page and product list); the stonehillfarmct.com pages could not be fetched this run. The store describes pasture-raised grassfed beef from intensive rotational grazing and a full beef cut list, plus eggs from the farm's own hens kept on pasture with the herd. Pickup is on the farm, arranged after the order is filled; no delivery or shipping and no quarter, half or whole beef found. The store also sells pork cuts and sausage without saying where the pigs are raised, so pork is left out. Category stays grass-fed because no finishing or no-grain wording was found. The BOTL Farm pickup point came from another site and was removed.
resold_note: Also sells pasture-raised chicken from White Oak Farm in Killingly, CT.
